v0.2.0-alpha.description:
# Changelog
- Fixed the inventory overflowing
- Fixed Conductor's Car Trash Bin and Library Table not randomizing
- Death link.
  - Incorrect deductions and dying in the THINK sections count as deaths
  - Received deaths either make you restart the THINK section or kick you out of dialog
  - Known Issue: Death Link is messed up during Final Push
- Deduction Sanity, correct (and optionally incorrect) deductions are checks
- Choice Sanity, choices in dialogs are checks (optionally can include missable choices)

v0.3.0-beta.description:
# Changelog
- Overhauled connection. You can now enter connection info from the main menu and have a stable save throughout the AP
- The number of save slots has been massively expanded
- Car Select now uses the Save/Load UI
- Car Select now loads from a known stable state
- The name entry now autofills to the slot name
- Added a close dialog button
- Death Link and Autoskip Dialog have been moved to the in-game options screen
- Added Entrance Rando, The exit from each car can now lead into a random car
- Split the runner sections into its own option
- Added options for multiple copies of inventory items or cars
- Fixed an inventory bug that required reconnecting to work around
v0.3.0-beta.title: v0.3.0-beta
